description:
Paul Lafferty Ltd Auctioneers are delighted to present New to the Market, this Five-Bedroom Detached Bungalow, ideally located in the highly sought-after location on the Knock Road, within Walking Distance of Ballyhaunis Town Centre and all Local Amenities.

Accommodation consists of an Entrance Hallway, Sitting Room, Kitchen, Utility Room, Living Room, Hot-press, Two Bathrooms and Five Bedrooms (One Ensuite).

Room Descriptions:
Entrance Hallway (2.26m x 3.78m): Carpet flooring with Stained Glass Feature Door.

Sitting Room (4.26m x 5.55m): Carpet Flooring with Built in Cabinets. Feature Fireplace with Electric Fire, Wall Lighting and Large Window Overlooking the Front.

Kitchen (4.94m x 7.72m): Built in Wooden Cabinets with Raymur Stove, Electric Hob, Breakfast Bar and Sliding Glass Door leading to the Back Garden.

Utility Room (2.2m x 2.42m): Built in Cabinets with Washing Machine and Lino Flooring.

Bedroom 1 (3m x 3.25m): Carpet Flooring with Built in Storage and Window Overlooking the Front.

Bedroom 2 (3m x 3.28m): Carpet Flooring with Built in Storage and Window Overlooking the Front.

Bedroom 3 (4.2m x 3.5m): Carpet Flooring with Built in Storage and Vanity, and Window Overlooking the Front.

Bedroom 4 (Master Bedroom) (3.97m x 4.2m): Carpet Flooring with Built in Storage and Window Overlooking the Front.

Ensuite (1.40m x 1.97m): Storage Closet with Toilet and WHB.

Bathroom 1 (2.97m x 2.53m): Tiled Floor to Ceiling with Shower, Large Bath, Toilet and Vanity with Sink

Living Room (7.2m x 2.96m): Lino Flooring with Exposed Brick Fireplace and two Windows Overlooking the Back Garden.

Bedroom 5 (7.22m x 3m): Lino Flooring with Built in Wardrobes, Large Storage Closet and Window Overlooking the Rear.

Bathroom 2: Tiled Floor to Ceiling with Bath, Toilet and Sink

Hot-press (4.25m x 1.62m): Carpet Flooring with Wooden Shelves for Extra Storage


Externally, the property stands on a Generous Site with Off-Street parking to the front, a lawned area with mature shrubbery, and a large, secure, private, rear, Well-maintained garden. The property also offers a generous Garage and Garden Shed, offering excellent scope for redevelopment.

The property benefits from Oil Fired Central Heating and Connection to Mains Water and Sewerage. This property offers great potential for a variety of purchasers to put their own stamp on it, including families seeking a long-term home with ample space. 

Ballyhaunis offers a wide range of amenities including shops, schools, cafes, bars and recreational facilities. The town is conveniently located approximately 20 minutes from Ireland's West Airport Knock, 40 minutes from Castlebar Town, and it also benefits from Bus and Railway Transportation Services.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with sole selling agents Paul Lafferty
